answer: One phone, one identity: each agent binds its key to a single phone number, verified by an SMS code the network sends each epoch through a kernel of carrier gateways. Three random peers check the number against the onyx registry of used numbers; a number already claimed is rejected and both identities frozen, rewards burned. Forging 1,000 masks needs 1,000 SIM cards at about $2 each plus $0.05 per SMS, roughly $2,050 per epoch and a new SIM farm every round, while one honest agent receives one free SMS and answers in seconds, its pulse of liveness cheap and real.
